projects.title: Prismet Arcade
projects.summary: Co-developed with Ben, Prismet brings classic games and useful data lenses into one library.
projects.history: Chess Hotswap began as the archived origin of Kaleidoscope, built to hot-swap between 2D and 3D chess.

projects.title: The Long Now
projects.summary: The Long Now explores colony-simulation storytelling with civilization-scale technological progression. Above the settlement is the floating castle of The Wizard, with rooms, small games and secrets to discover. Moving between the castle and the mortals below is the core idea.

projects.title: PrismCode
projects.summary: PrismCode developed the engineering workspace for Claude Code, Codex and DeepSeek: agent panes, transcripts, approvals, terminals, files, Git, diffs, sessions and usage tracking. Its worktree comparison workflow puts proposed changes side by side before adoption.

projects.title: Steam Rewind
projects.summary: A set of lenses for exploring a Steam library through playtime, value and the games left waiting. The browser tool offers a built-in demonstration library, so the interface can be explored without connecting a personal account.

projects.title: Accessible Debt Clock
projects.summary: An accessible debt clock that grew into a public financial-data explorer.

projects.title: Cicero
projects.summary: The earlier Cicero council interface brought a Curia transcript, Legion panel, All-Hands fleet and verdict into one view. Its council ideas later joined the PrismCode engineering workspace in a unified Cicero desktop source tree.

projects.title: Helix Research Desk
projects.summary: A local-first macOS workbench for personal, non-clinical genetics research. Its source adapters bring public evidence into a common view with identity checks, provenance, dates and visible conflicts. A local notebook keeps research snapshots and notes.

projects.title: Axiom Extension experiments
projects.summary: Parallel Minecraft Axiom-extension experiments with separate Claude and Codex source trees.

projects.title: QR Scanner & pocket tools
projects.summary: Four small browser projects: a camera-based QR scanner, a phone-declutter checklist, a home-screen planner and an Apple Music playlist experiment.

projects.title: Screen Protection
projects.summary: An archived screen-protection placeholder. The inventory did not establish substantive source or a finished application.

projects.title: Escape Revert
projects.summary: A macOS utility that turns three rapid Escape presses into the standard Back keyboard shortcut.

projects.title: HOI4 AI War Room
projects.summary: A local cockpit project for following Hearts of Iron IV through a game stream and a separate control and standings interface. The existing captures show the game and its own observer console; they do not show the complete cockpit or establish autonomous agent play.

projects.title: Civilization V Mod Profiles
projects.summary: A Mac workflow for switching Civilization V between a conservative mod stack and an experimental native-compatible stack. The project evolved from the photographed Choose Your Build menu into separate Stable and Risky launcher buttons.

projects.title: Yggdrasil
projects.summary: Yggdrasil explores bringing FromSoftware worlds into one Elden Ring installation, starting with Dark Souls III. Map conversion, collision, materials, lighting and progression all need to work together.

projects.title: WoW Sidepanel
projects.summary: A World of Warcraft addon prototype exploring a reserved right-side UI strip for ultrawide or multi-monitor arrangements.

projects.title: Usage Tracker
projects.summary: A local dashboard that aggregates coding-agent usage and shows estimated API-equivalent cost.

projects.title: Helm
projects.summary: Helm is a custom KDE Plasma desktop: native QML instruments for clocks, CPU, GPU, network and storage, alongside small arcade games and controls for arranging the workspace. Shared panel components and palette tokens give the instruments one visual language.

projects.title: PlexSquish
projects.summary: PlexSquish pairs a Mac control panel with a Go service for preparing HEVC media encodes, following progress and verifying output before replacement. Its recorded acceptance used synthetic clips; current operation on a personal media library is not established.

projects.title: Airhorn
projects.summary: A deliberately small Electron app for Mac: one large red button plays a bundled air-horn recording. Space triggers the same action, and repeated presses can overlap. The recording is “Air Horn” by Mike Koenig, credited under CC BY 3.0.

projects.title: Bayzyl
projects.summary: Selections, shapes, brushes, clipboards, persistent undo, shared kits, and builder profiles, in one consistent command set.

projects.title: Quark
projects.summary: A personal-hub prototype for bringing mail, calendars, code and files into one tabbed desktop window.

projects.title: Westeros for UEBS 2
projects.summary: A Westeros-inspired map project for Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2. The retained local candidate has editor and native-tool evidence. In-game battle behavior and a public Workshop release have not been established for this record.

projects.title: Command Helm
projects.summary: Command Helm is a personal VSCodium-based editor shaped around coding-agent work, custom panels and terminal continuity. A separate public-preview candidate explores a cleaner first-run experience; it is not presented as a public or notarized release.

projects.title: Command Helm Remote
projects.summary: An iPhone companion for sending coding tasks to two computers and following reports, questions, and project status.

projects.title: Castra
projects.summary: Castra brings agent activity, plain-language orders and their reports into a shared development desk.

projects.title: Prismet Station
projects.summary: Prismet Station organizes an agent-assisted art-print experiment into rooms, tasks and drafts. Its current manual and dry-run workflows support preparation and review without claiming autonomous income, public listings or completed fulfillment.

projects.title: Account Helm
projects.summary: A menu-bar launcher for up to four separately configured coding CLI sessions, keeping each terminal's launch identity stable.

projects.title: Block by Block
projects.summary: An educational Minecraft platform with checkable lessons, saved progress, achievements, and a server-independent lesson engine.

projects.title: Blue Team
projects.summary: Read-only device posture and drift audits, with staged hardening and rollback-aware operations.

projects.title: Paige
projects.summary: A local console for preparing customer-message drafts with a knowledge pack, pricing rules, and review gates.

projects.title: Cohort
projects.summary: A coding-agent orchestrator with provider discovery, cost restrictions, repository preservation, and review and verification steps.

projects.title: Prismet Lab
projects.summary: A native STEM workspace combining formulas, units, statistics, figures, citations, and report composition in local project packages.

projects.title: Council Room
projects.summary: Council Room is an earlier native Mac interface for streaming conversations with local-model personas. A sequential council mode lets each reply build on earlier turns. It belongs to the history of the later Castra assistant workflow.

projects.title: HelmScanner
projects.summary: A native macOS network dashboard and widget with connection sightings, local evidence views, manual checks, and Windscribe status controls.

projects.title: Spelltower MC
projects.summary: A private Minecraft server operations toolkit with backups and a native Mac control surface.

projects.title: Cicero for iOS
projects.summary: An iPhone council companion with a forum dashboard, historian, and durable request inbox.

projects.title: KYZER
projects.summary: KYZER explored a Python assistant built around locally hosted models, explicit memory and a command-line/API workflow. It established an early scaffold for later local-agent work. The original service was retired in favor of Castra, and its unfinished roadmap remains historical.

projects.title: Labienus QLoRA
projects.summary: Labienus QLoRA explores adapting a locally hosted Nemotron assistant to development and operations work.

projects.title: Helix Medical Model Research
projects.summary: Helix medical-model research combines parameter-efficient training scripts, dataset preparation and evaluation tooling.

projects.title: AlexeiChat
projects.summary: A two-person translation messenger with Electron clients, a WebSocket relay, and server-side translation.

projects.title: Fable clean-room skills
projects.summary: A collection of agent workflows for clean-room research, compatibility checks, and systems implementation.

projects.title: YGGDRASIL Launch Menu
projects.summary: A native in-game launch-menu preview with guarded handoff and isolated test modes.

projects.title: RimWorld Vanilla+ pack
projects.summary: A curated RimWorld 1.6 preset with dependency auditing, installation records, and reproducible load-order notes.

projects.title: SplTwr
projects.summary: A personal compatibility toolkit for running Windows games and mod managers on macOS, with launch recipes and recorded experiments.

projects.title: Helm iOS prototype
projects.summary: An early iPhone home-network control surface with mesh, media-compression, and quick-action views.

projects.title: AlarmClock
projects.summary: A SwiftUI alarm-clock prototype with alarm editing, weekday selection, settings, and notification service code.

projects.title: Minecraft mesh monitor
projects.summary: A Python dashboard for watching a personal Minecraft server mesh.

projects.title: Music Helm
projects.summary: Music Helm explores building a listening route around the order of a chosen playlist or album. The installed app opened to a ready Now screen. A newer Route Studio source adds review, replacement and undo for suggested discoveries; that source is distinct from the installed app.

projects.title: MeshRecall
projects.summary: Two cooperating Minecraft plugins that remember a player's last server and position across a Velocity mesh.

projects.title: BayzylBridge
projects.summary: A separate Minecraft chat bridge with plugin and client components for the personal server workflow.

projects.title: ATV Remote customization
projects.summary: A customized Apple TV remote interface with navigation, text input, volume controls, and app launching.

projects.title: Spellbook Deck
projects.summary: A lightweight Mac desktop panel with clock, calendar, battery, memory and storage cards, plus a remote-screen shortcut.

projects.title: Taberna
projects.summary: Taberna is an installable web app where three local AI residents take turns in a shared conversation. A chess table extends the room with legal-move handling, spectators, ratings and saved game history. Current remote access and notification delivery remain unverified.

projects.title: Local Persona Agents
projects.summary: This sidecar gives several local-model assistants shared context, research helpers and consistent terminal launchers.

projects.title: HELM VM Image Tooling
projects.summary: HELM VM Image Tooling builds an ARM Linux guest filesystem and packages the kernel, initial RAM filesystem and compressed root image. A checksum manifest records the generated artifacts. A successful guest boot has not been verified.

projects.title: Audio Transcription Pipeline
projects.summary: A GPU-backed transcription experiment records progress for individual audio items and checks output completeness before treating a batch as finished. The recorded batch stopped when a timestamp validation failed. Human review and complete delivery remain outstanding.

projects.title: Uncle Scam
projects.summary: Uncle Scam turns a salary and ZIP code into an estimated tax receipt, with federal, state and supported local calculations. Spending breakdowns, source dates and partial-estimate labels make the result inspectable; the calculations run in the browser.

projects.title: LinkedIn Connect
projects.summary: A personal browser-automation prototype for LinkedIn connection workflows. It is retained as development work; this portfolio makes no claim of customer outcomes or messages sent.

projects.title: Local API Proxy
projects.summary: A local API proxy experiment with configurable response filtering and retry handling. Its source explores request and response behavior; this record does not claim improved model quality or a safety guarantee.

projects.title: Audiobookshelf iOS Development Build
projects.summary: This project adapts the upstream Audiobookshelf mobile app for a personal iPhone development installation.
